title: Liberty Global (LBTYK) Holding Increased by Marshall Wace Llp
text:
Liberty Global (LBTYK) Holding Increased by Marshall Wace Llp
June 16, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Paul Marshall increased its stake in Liberty Global (LBTYK) by 260.17% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marshall Wace Llp bought 1.09M shares as the company’s stock declined 11.63% with the market. The hedge fund run by Paul Marshall held 1.51M shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $45.88 million, up from 418,655 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marshall Wace Llp who had been investing in Liberty Global for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.15 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.17% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $28.71. About 1.86M shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 7.09% since June 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.66% the S&P500.
Marshall Wace Llp, which manages about $2.41 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 281,611 shares to 132,423 shares, valued at $21.16 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in A by 129,120 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 13,614 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
